title: Fifty Years of Wave Equations with Time-Dependent Propagation Speeds: A Variational Perspective and New Frontiers
summary: We study abstract wave equations with time-dependent propagation speed under strict hyperbolicity. Our starting point is the observation that a substantial part of the classical energy theory, developed through different constructions, can be organized around a common variational mechanism. Approximate energies naturally lead to regularity--fidelity problems in which a smooth approximation of the reciprocal propagation speed is chosen by balancing derivative size against distance from the original coefficient.
